concerns: wc -l counts newlines: the file must end with exactly one newline or AC1's `wc -l` prints 0. The write tool writes content verbatim; include the trailing newline explicitly and check with wc -l before committing.
AC2's allow-list admits docs/solutions/ only after the retro; a docs/ path before approval is a defect the reviewer must flag.
Docs-only diff: skill://ce-simplify-code and the thermonuclear pair do not run and the Thermo line is omitted from the PR body (references/pr-body.md). A reviewer must not request them.

Only plan.json, test.json, and a changes_requested review.json pushes skip CI; the implement.json push and every code push run both workflows, so expect several CI runs. Cite the run ids at the final head in the CI line.

The proof's headSha is the code commit at the time of the proof; the implement handoff commit above it changes nothing under smoke/, so the PR head differs from the proof head only by .legion/implement.json. State that in the E2E line rather than re-running at the handoff head.
AC3 is reviewer-triggered and optional; if exercised, every proof (implementer and tester) is re-run at the new head and the PR body's E2E lines and the handoff headSha values are updated.
Every issue workspace shares one jj clone: no jj abandon/undo/op restore; a wrong committer on another role's commit is reported to the architect, never accepted.
integration: Implementer .legion/ deletion push at the reviewer's direction (legion threads resolve first; PR body Threads section updated).
Retro: the implementer is revived per skill://legion-retro; its learnings file lands under docs/solutions/ (the one extra path AC2 allows) and is pushed; CI runs on it.
Merger READY (skill://legion-worker/references/merge-gate.md). Legion never merges; a human merges the PR under the repository's protections.
Implementer production check = AC4; then the architect signs off and closes the root.
